elText: Fakitin da aka fi amfani da su suna tsakiya; duk abin da ke kewaye da su an gina shi a kansu. Mafi amfani zuwa {date}: {top}. {ddd} daga cikin waɗannan fakiti {n} an gina su a kan DDD. Girman kusurwa shida shi ne babban fayil na kowane fakiti, da aka matsa da gzip; zane na zinariya yana nuna fakitin da wasu 20 ko fiye ke amfani da su.

platText: Dukansu suna aiki da tsarin rukunin yanar gizo ɗaya, site.json: wasu suna tafiyar da rukunin yanar gizo, wasu suna gina su ko gyara su, kuma PRAW yana riƙe da dokokinsa.
platKey: Masu launi: kadarorin da ke cikin sandar hanyar sadarwa ta HAX, cikin launukan hanyar sadarwarsu. Toka: dandamalin da ke tafiyar da gina HAX. Girma yana ƙaruwa da commit zuwa yau; zobe yana bugawa da commit na kowane wata.
siteIntro: Baƙo yana karanta wasu shafuka na rukunin yanar gizo na HAX ɗaya, sannan ya koma rukunin yanar gizo na gaba a kan mai masaukin baki ɗaya. Tsakanin shafukan rukunin yanar gizo, abubuwan da shafin ya ƙara kawai ake ɗauko.
themeIntro: Baƙo yana buɗe rukunin yanar gizo na HAX ɗaya bayan ɗaya a kan mai masaukin baki ɗaya, kowanne da jigo daban, bisa tsarin da aka yi jigogin.

laterStep: Wannan mataki yana buƙatar {need}; {cached} daga ciki tuni yana cikin ma'ajiya, don haka yana ɗauko {fetch} kawai.

sources: Kwanakin wata: lokacin da kowane fayil ya bayyana a hanyarsa ta yanzu, da commit na farko na kowace ma'ajiya. Baiti: gzip na tushen kowane fayil, fayil bayan fayil, ba tare da lambar wasu ɓangarori ba. Masu bincike suna riƙe ma'ajiya ɗaya ga kowane rukunin yanar gizo, don haka ajiya tsakanin rukunin yanar gizo tana aiki a kan mai masaukin baki ɗaya.
